title: Evidence and limits
body:
As of 2026-10-24, full Architecture Intentions dev10 text tree is in GitHub at packages/oorexx_architecture_intentions/ with 14 .cls members. The NotNotes historical v0.1-dev15 core archive was also recovered at packages/alchemy_notnotes/ (three source classes, original tests, demos and external dependency records). The three NotNotes source Git blob SHA-1 values were compared to exact source archive bytes.

Dev10 ZIP SHA-256: 493c2e98b2a04543bb3d6b9e50240c3254dab275024ff127a220ab8197afaa24. Static checks passed: 26 JSON documents parse, bash -n for test runner, MANIFEST.sha256, ZIP CRC. The dev10 test_notnotes_publication.rex was authored but NOT executed in a native interpreter; ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 is unavailable in this execution environment.

Dev8 historical logs attest earlier r13196 regression and ConnectSelector/Intention Service tests, but cannot substitute for dev10 runtime qualification. There is no claimed live NotNotes write, document revision CAS, identity/policy qualification, production SSC lock, deployment target verification or Gopher semantic lint run.
summary: Source backfill complete; static checks only for dev10, native and authority integration remain pending.
invariants: Architecture selection and review never authorize execution
Unknown qualification fails closed and remains visible
Each external component retains its own semantic and provenance authority

provenance.claim: Source delivery with static qualification; native dev10 qualification outstanding
Historical NotNotes executable source recovered on GitHub
